smallest_supported_claim: This source-bound, zero-credit setup run native-saved an explicitly artificial daytime open-field footing with one player-visible hostile zombie rider eight tiles east of the avatar.  It establishes only the saved tactical starting state for a separate ordinary account.
causal_account: The run used the native debug menu only to set daytime, teleport to an open location, and place the selected rider through the native cursor.  It did not inject attention, knowledge, contact, an observer, a route, an attack, or a recovery.  The final World observation shows exactly the placed visible rider; the World Save and Quit action and its native confirmation were accepted.  This setup earns no ordinary-gameplay credit.
